thread:
Samir (AE): quick sync — NovumHealth POC is greenlit by product but procurement threw in two extra asks: (1) signature must be by UK rep with PoA, (2) they want the order form to include a notarized addendum and explicit remit-to bank fields. Also they requested Net45 on the PO. Can we confirm acceptability?

Tara (Legal): @Samir thanks. Two immediate Qs: do they insist on wet-ink notarization or will e-notarization suffice? We can accept DocuSign Notary or a locally recognized e-notary / electronic affidavit. Wet-ink would slow the process.

Linh (RevOps): I uploaded the PO + vendor packet here: https://drive.redwood/novum/poc_vendor_packet.pdf. PO entity = "NovumHealth Ltd" (UK). There's also a PoA scan in the folder.

Novum Procurement Bot: PO uploaded by procurement@novumhealth.co.uk. Attached: purchase_order_4312.pdf, power_of_attorney.pdf, remit_details_blank.docx.

Mark (Finance): Net45 is acceptable but we need: beneficiary name on the bank account exactly matching invoiced legal entity, plus bank SWIFT/IBAN and local tax form (UK: VAT registration or equivalent). If PoA signatory name doesn't match beneficiary, we need a corporate letter confirming signatory authority.

Olivia (SE): From delivery side — customer asked for a 99.95% SLA for Dedicated during POC. We can offer that with committed capacity and a short appendix specifying GPUs/throughput. Ops will need at least 48h notice to provision.

Samir (AE): They’re saying PoA already has a notary stamp (scanned). I flagged name mismatch: PoA signs "Jonathan Meyers" but PO signer listed as "J. Meyers". Procurement says that’s fine. Legal/Finance — is that acceptable or need corrected doc?

Tara (Legal): Name abbreviation is risky. Options: (a) request corrected PoA signed by exact printed name, (b) get a cover letter on company letterhead confirming signatory, or (c) enhanced KYC (company registry extract) showing Jonathan = J. Meyers. I'll draft a redline to cover these scenarios and include optional e-notary language.

Mark (Finance): +1 to Tara. Also require completed remit block on the order form. Please have them populate this sample: 

```
Remit-To: [Bank name]\nAccount Name / Beneficiary: [Legal entity name as on invoice]\nIBAN / Account #: [IBAN or account number]\nSort Code / SWIFT / BIC: [as applicable]\nPayment Terms: Net45
```

Samir (AE): I'll ask them to fill that out and upload corrected PoA or the letter. I'll also confirm if e-notary is acceptable.

Tara (Legal): I'll produce a single redline package (MSA + Order Form + DPA) that: (1) allows DocuSign Notary or equivalent e-notarization, (2) requires PoA dated within 12 months and either notarized or backed by a company letter, (3) inserts brief SLA credit fallback for 99.95. I'll send to Samir for sharing.

Linh (RevOps): FYI — our billing system requires the remit beneficiary to match the contract entity. If they want payments to a different affiliated company we need a vendor change request and intercompany paperwork.

Olivia (SE): If they accept e-notary and provide PoA/letter, operations can fast-track the Dedicated pool once finance confirms billing entity. I'll draft the appendix for committed units and put a provisioning timeline in the order form appendix.

Samir (AE): Great. I'll push the redline + request for (1) completed remit block, (2) corrected PoA or letter, (3) confirmation re: e-notary. Will ping when they reply. :thumbsup:

Novum Procurement Bot: Novum procurement replied: "We can provide a company letter on letterhead and a scanned notary-stamped PoA. E-notary acceptable if Redwood confirms same."

Tara (Legal): That's workable. I'll note required evidence chain in the redline and include language: "Signature authority must be evidenced by a Power of Attorney dated within the prior 12 months, or a corporate letter on company letterhead confirming authority to sign, and, where provided electronically, an e-notarization via DocuSign Notary or equivalent shall be acceptable."

Mark (Finance): Once we get completed remit details and name confirmation, finance approves Net45. We'll validate bank details before first invoice.

Samir (AE): Sending redline now. Will update thread when Novum returns cleared docs. Thanks all.
